long.text: Learn enough about how lidar reveals buried structures to tell a real find from a wishful one, and eventually write a short page I would stand behind.
long.reason: The lidar finds keep pulling at me, and a day of skimming will not be enough to understand them.

steps.reason: Lidar subtracts the terrain model from each return, and I have never read what that model actually is.
The sand has been open for a while. A small sketch will show me what I understand about it better than another read.
Writing the terrain model down will show whether I can explain it without the page open.
Writing and making are tiring. A stretch of nothing before the last reading of the day.
Forest canopy keeps returning to the lidar work, and leaf area index is how the canopy gets counted.
